results.title: CIIE becomes vital platform for BRI partner countries to tap China’s mega market - Global Times
results.snippet: Marking its ninth consecutive year participating in the expo, Standard Bank Group leads a delegation of 20 African businesses from seven countries to this year’s CIIE, seeking to connect African exporters with Chinese buyers, investors and business partners. The delegation includes companies from South Africa, Ghana, Nigeria, Kenya, Malawi, Tanzania and Uganda, covering sectors such as agriculture
